-- [주민 외형 실물 검증] 기존 장면·R15·승인 자산을 읽기만 한다. 저장·복장 상태는 수정하지 않는다.
local scene=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene"),"VILLAGER_SCENE_MISSING")
local checked,ready,baseBody,hairReady,hairExpected,garments,overlap,whiteBoot=0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
local missing,hairProblems={},{}
for _,actor in scene:GetDescendants() do
 if actor:IsA("Model") and actor:GetAttribute("NpcAssetProfile") then
  checked+=1
  if actor:GetAttribute("NpcAppearanceState")=="ready" then ready+=1 end
  local miss=actor:GetAttribute("OutfitMissing")
  if type(miss)=="string" and #miss>0 then
   table.insert(missing,tostring(actor:GetAttribute("NpcAssetProfile"))..":"..miss)
  end
  if actor:FindFirstChild("R15Asset_male_peasant_body_UpperTorso")
   or actor:FindFirstChild("R15Asset_female_peasant_body_UpperTorso")
   or actor:FindFirstChild("R15Asset_male_ranger_body_UpperTorso")
   or actor:FindFirstChild("R15Asset_female_ranger_body_UpperTorso") then baseBody+=1 end
  local hairStyle=actor:GetAttribute("NpcHairStyle")
  if hairStyle=="short" or hairStyle=="long" or hairStyle=="bun" then
   hairExpected+=1
   if actor:GetAttribute("NpcHairMeshReady")==true then
    hairReady+=1
   else
    local worn={}
    for _,slot in actor:GetChildren() do
     if slot:IsA("Model") and slot.Name:sub(1,14)=="R15Asset_hair_" then
      local showing=0
      for _,part in slot:GetDescendants() do
       if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency<0.95 and part.LocalTransparencyModifier<0.95 then showing+=1 end
      end
      table.insert(worn,slot.Name..":"..showing)
     end
    end
    local fallback=actor:FindFirstChild("Hair")
    table.insert(hairProblems,tostring(actor:GetAttribute("NpcAssetProfile")).."/"..tostring(actor:GetAttribute("AppearanceProfession")).."/"..hairStyle.."/slots="..table.concat(worn,",").."/fallback="..tostring(fallback and fallback.Transparency))
   end
  end
  local vest,coat=false,false
  for _,item in actor:GetChildren() do
   if item:IsA("Model") and item.Name:sub(1,16)=="R15Asset_outfit_" then
    for _,part in item:GetDescendants() do
     if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency<0.95 and part.LocalTransparencyModifier<0.99 then
      garments+=1
      if item.Name=="R15Asset_outfit_vest_UpperTorso" then vest=true end
      if item.Name=="R15Asset_outfit_coat_UpperTorso" then coat=true end
      if item.Name:find("R15Asset_outfit_boot_",1,true) then
       local surface=part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
       local shade=if surface then surface.Color else part.Color
       local neutral=math.max(shade.R,shade.G,shade.B)-math.min(shade.R,shade.G,shade.B)<0.12
       if not surface and (not part:IsA("MeshPart") or part.TextureID=="")
        and shade.R>0.80 and shade.G>0.79 and shade.B>0.76 and neutral then whiteBoot+=1 end
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
  if vest and coat then overlap+=1 end
 end
end
local report=string.format("VILLAGER_OUTFIT_RUNTIME_AUDIT checked=%d ready=%d baseBody=%d hairReady=%d/%d visibleGarmentParts=%d overlap=%d whiteBoot=%d missing=%d hairFailures=[%s]",checked,ready,baseBody,hairReady,hairExpected,garments,overlap,whiteBoot,#missing,table.concat(hairProblems," | ",1,math.min(8,#hairProblems)))
assert(checked>=10,"VILLAGER_RUNTIME_ROSTER_MISSING:"..report)
assert(ready>=checked-2,"VILLAGER_RUNTIME_NOT_READY:"..report)
assert(baseBody>=10,"VILLAGER_BASE_BODY_MISSING:"..report)
assert(hairExpected>=10,"VILLAGER_HAIR_PROFILE_EMPTY:"..report)
assert(garments>=10,"VILLAGER_OUTFIT_RENDER_EMPTY:"..report)
assert(overlap==0,"VILLAGER_OUTFIT_LAYER_OVERLAP:"..report)
assert(whiteBoot==0,"VILLAGER_WHITE_BOOT_UNTEXTURED:"..report)
assert(#missing==0,"VILLAGER_OUTFIT_MISSING:"..table.concat(missing," | ",1,math.min(5,#missing)))
return report

-- [헤어 전수 판정] 직전 진단 단계의 상세 결과가 먼저 로그에 저장된 뒤 실패를 알린다.
-- 동일한 실제 게임 모델만 재확인하고 새 캐릭터/자산/저장 변경은 하지 않는다.
local scene=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene"),"VILLAGER_SCENE_MISSING")
local expected,visible=0,0
for _,actor in scene:GetDescendants() do
 if actor:IsA("Model") and actor:GetAttribute("NpcAssetProfile") then
  local style=actor:GetAttribute("NpcHairStyle")
  if style=="short" or style=="long" or style=="bun" then
   expected+=1
   if actor:GetAttribute("NpcHairMeshReady")==true then visible+=1 end
  end
 end
end
assert(expected>=10,"VILLAGER_HAIR_PROFILE_EMPTY:"..expected)
assert(visible==expected,("VILLAGER_HAIR_NOT_READY:%d/%d"):format(visible,expected))
return ("VILLAGER_HAIR_RUNTIME_PASS:%d/%d"):format(visible,expected)
